project: Time-series Neural Network Software Suite and App Development for Dairy Herd Monitoring
summary: Investigate dairy-herd activity and temperature through a desktop research suite for data upload, neural-model training and visualisation.
decision: Keep model training and data processing separate from Tkinter callbacks. A long-running fit should report progress through a queue, while only the main GUI thread updates widgets.
tradeoff: Desktop execution keeps research files local and allows specialised Python libraries. A future service adds remote access but introduces model-job scheduling, access control and dataset governance requirements.
contract: Record animal identifier, measurement time, activity and temperature with units. Evaluate on later time periods and unseen animals where appropriate; fit preprocessing on training data only.
limits: The original research prototype is not a validated veterinary diagnostic service. The browser workbench compares a trailing-mean baseline on invented activity values; it is not the original neural network and its MAE is illustrative.
